job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Account Manager - FM Service Provider - North West London - Up to £90,000

This is an exciting opportunity to work for an established FM service provider located in NW London. CBW are currently seeking an experienced Account Manager to oversee the delivery of all hard FM services across a new and large estate. The successful candidate will be M&E qualified with a proven track record in facilities management. You will be responsible for managing dedicated on-site engineering teams, ensuring all planned and reactive maintenance activities are completed to the highest standards, and that the properties operate efficiently on a day-to-day basis.

Hours of work

Monday to Friday - 08:00am to 17:00pm

Key duties & responsibilities
  • Report directly to the Account Director
  • Manage agreed KPI and SLA's.
  • Responsible for managing the company's H&S and environmental performance on the contract.
  • Plan and implement building shutdowns and complex client project works.
  • Responsible for managing the company's quality procedures on site
  • Recruitment of any new staff
  • Responsible for the development of all staff, which will include annual appraisals.
  • Manage staff absenteeism and be responsible for disciplinary issues
  • Management of client relationships on a daily basis.
  • Management of all reports.
  • Manage any additional business opportunities that will deliver client satisfaction and increase contract sales revenue
  • Offer technical support to both the client and the engineering team
  • Responsible for the permit system.
  • Attend client meetings
  • Financial understanding/experience (P&L etc)
Requirements

  • Qualified in an engineering discipline (Electrical or Mechanical); C&G, HNC, HND or higher.
  • Experience of service delivery across a commercial portfolio (Hard Services)
  • Previous experience of managing an FM engineering team.
  • A proven track record in commercial building maintenance
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of staff and clients.
  • Ability to manage and prioritise a demanding and varying workload.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills

job.title: Contract Manager
job.description:
Contract Manager – FM Service Provider – West London – £80,000 per annum

Are you an experienced Hard Services Contract Manager looking to take ownership of a high-profile commercial portfolio in West London?

CBW is recruiting for an experienced Contract Manager to join a leading FM service provider, taking responsibility for the hard FM delivery across a small portfolio of prestigious commercial buildings in West London, all located within easy walking distance of one another. The successful candidate will lead a dedicated on-site team consisting of engineers, supervisors and administrative support, taking overall responsibility for engineering performance, compliance, client relationships, financial management and the day-to-day delivery of the contract. With multiple buildings, a busy commercial environment and a highly professional client base, this role would suit an established Contract Manager who enjoys being visible on site, technically involved and commercially accountable, while developing a strong relationship with the client.

Hours of Work

Monday to Friday – 08:00 to 17:00

Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Report directly to the Operations Manager and take overall responsibility for the day-to-day delivery of the contract.
  • Lead and manage the on-site engineering, supervisory and administrative teams across the portfolio.
  • Oversee all planned preventative and reactive maintenance, ensuring high standards of service delivery across each building.
  • Manage contract KPIs and SLAs, ensuring performance targets are consistently achieved.
  • Act as a key point of contact for the client, developing strong relationships and maintaining a visible presence across the portfolio.
  • Take ownership of health, safety, environmental and statutory compliance across the contract.
  • Plan and coordinate building shutdowns, major maintenance activities and complex client projects.
  • Manage specialist subcontractors and ensure works are completed safely and to the required standard.
  • Oversee and maintain the permit-to-work system.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to supervisors, engineers and the client.
  • Lead recruitment, onboarding, development and performance management of the site team.
  • Conduct annual appraisals and support the continued development of team members.
  • Manage contract reporting and provide clear updates on operational and technical performance.
  • Maintain responsibility for budgets, P&L and overall financial performance.
  • Identify opportunities for additional works and contract growth while continuing to improve the client experience.
  • Attend and lead client meetings, providing operational, technical and commercial updates.
  • Ensure company quality procedures and standards are maintained throughout the contract.
Requirements
  • Recognised Electrical or Mechanical engineering qualification – City & Guilds, HNC, HND or equivalent/higher.
  • Previous experience managing Hard FM services within a large commercial building or multi-building estate.
  • Proven experience managing engineering teams, supervisors and specialist subcontractors.
  • Strong technical knowledge of commercial building services and maintenance.
  • Previous responsibility for KPIs, SLAs, compliance, budgets and P&L.
  • Strong client-facing skills with the confidence to build relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills.
  • Ability to manage and prioritise a varied and demanding workload.
This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Contract Manager to take ownership of a prestigious West London commercial portfolio, leading an established engineering operation within a modern and fast-paced environment.

Please send your CV to Katie at CBW Staffing Solutions for more information.

job.title: Contract Support
job.description:
Contract Support (Construction)– Glasgow South Side - 25-28K DOE

CBW are looking for a Assistant Planner to join a construction team, supporting the delivery of renewable installation and Energy as a Service programme.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, proactive and keen to develop a career in project coordination. You don't need previous experience in renewable energy, construction or installation — they will provide structured on-the-job training and support to help you develop your skills.

Working closely with Project Coordinators and the Site Team, you’ll play an important role in keeping projects moving, ensuring appointments are coordinated, documentation is complete and information is accurately recorded.

As your knowledge and confidence grow, you’ll gradually take on more responsibility, with the opportunity to progress towards a Project Coordinator position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scheduling & Project Coordination
  • Support Project Coordinators with the planning and scheduling of installation works.
  • Help coordinate surveyors, installers and contractors to meet customer, client and funder deadlines.
  • Assist with arranging site access, customer appointments and pre-installation requirements.
  • Keep project schedules
  • Assist with preparing, issuing, and tracking job packs, checking that required paperwork, permissions, and
    compliance documentation are in place prior to works commencing.
  • Support accurate record-keeping within Big Change, learning to log job cards, timesheets, and completion
    evidence correctly.
  • Help chase outstanding documentation from surveyors, installers, and contractors, escalating persistent gaps to
    the Project Coordinator.
To be considered:

  • Some experience in an administrative, customer service, or support role; previous experience within
    construction, installation, or renewable energy is not essential.
  • Good organisational skills with a willingness to learn how to manage multiple schedules, deadlines, and
    stakeholders.
  • Confident user of Microsoft Office (particularly Excel), with the ability to quickly learn new systems such as Big
    Change.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with a professional manner when dealing with clients,
    contractors, and internal teams.
  • Good attention to detail, particularly when supporting compliance documentation and job records.
  • A proactive, enthusiastic approach to learning, taking direction, and building new skills.
  • Ability to work well as part of a team, taking direction from Project Coordinators and Project Managers.
Salary & Benefits: 

  • 25-28K
  • 28 days holiday
  • Private pension
  • Growth & development

job.title: Air Conditioning Engineer
job.description:
Mobile Air Conditioning Engineer – Northamptonshire – Global Facilities Management Organisation

CBW Staffing Solutions are seeking a skilled Air Conditioning Engineer to join our client’s team of facilities management professionals. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in HVAC maintenance and repair, responsible for maintaining and servicing air conditioning systems to ensure optimal performance and end-client satisfaction.

This is a mobile role, covering a regional patch from Northampton across to Leicester and Coventry.

Package
  • Competitive salary up to £47,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Van & fuel card supplied
  • Core hours are Monday - Friday (40 hours per week)
  • Participation in an ‘out of hours’ on call rota (to be confirmed)
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities
  • Maintain, service and troubleshoot a variety of air conditioning systems, including split systems, VRV/VRF systems, and chillers
  • Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as cleaning coils, replacing filters, moving parts, to prolong the lifespan of HVAC equipment
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical and electrical faults in air conditioning units, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum efficiency
  • Conduct inspections and assessments of HVAC systems to identify potential issues and recommend appropriate solutions
  • Collaborate with other maintenance personnel and contractors to coordinate complex repairs and system upgrades
  • Adhere to safety protocols and industry regulations to promote a safe working environment
Qualifications
  • Proven experience as an Air Conditioning Engineer or similar role within the facilities management industry
  • Hold your F-Gas Cat 1 Regulations certification
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, including installation, maintenance, and repair techniques
  • Familiarity with refrigeration principles and equipment
  • Proficiency in diagnosing and troubleshooting mechanical and electrical faults
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Effective communication and customer service skills
If you are a dedicated Air Conditioning Engineer, looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Maintenance Supervisor

My client is looking for someone who is highly organised, accurate and confident working with invoices and financial administration.

You will ideally have experience in an accounts or finance environment, particularly with invoicing, purchase orders, managing shared mailboxes and working with online client portals.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and experience using accounting systems.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join an established business and take responsibility for a varied finance role, with a particular focus on client invoicing, purchase orders, mailbox management and portal submissions.

The role will involve overseeing electrical engineering resources, including HV and LV systems, while ensuring critical infrastructure remains safe, compliant and operational. This is a key leadership position requiring a strong combination of technical knowledge, people management, commercial awareness and operational experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate additional works, lifecycle replacement programmes and the procurement of equipment and materials.
  • Monitor external contractors and supply chain partners, ensuring performance, compliance, quality and safety requirements are maintained.
  • Promote a positive Health, Safety and Environmental culture through regular inspections, reporting and proactive risk management.
  • Ensure statutory, technical and contractual documentation remains accurate and up to date.
  • Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring any identified actions are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders, attending meetings and providing accurate performance updates and reports.
  • Maintain training records, competency information and technical appointment registers.
  • Manage team performance, including appraisals, development plans and ongoing training requirements.
  • Work closely with the central Service Desk to support workforce planning and maintain operational continuity.
  • Ensure operational procedures, LOPs and technical documentation remain compliant with legislation and industry best practice.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours/on-call management rota as required.
  • Prepare regular contract performance, energy management and operational reports.
  • Monitor budgets, expenditure and financial forecasts to ensure effective commercial management.
  • Support and promote organisational values relating to ethics, equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties required by the Line Manager.
Benefits and Package The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
  • Life assurance equivalent to twice your annual salary.
  • Employee discounts with a wide range of major retailers and brands.
  • Gym membership discounts.
  • Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Holiday purchase scheme.
  •  £55,000 plus uplift for AP And HP and on-ca;;
Essential Requirements
  • HNC/HND in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
  • Recognised electrical qualifications and/or fully qualified electrician status.
  • At least five years' post-qualification experience within a comparable technical or contract management position.
  • Demonstrable experience managing electrical and hard services within a contractual environment.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Good commercial and financial management experience.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Disclosure Scotland/PVG clearance.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and CAFM systems.
Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience working within healthcare facilities management.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare technical standards, including SHTM 06-01, SHTM 06-02 and SHTM 06-03.
  • LV and HV Authorised/Approved Person experience or certification.
  • Knowledge of Confined Spaces, Fire Safety and Lift management.
  • Experience managing projects and delivering works within a live operational environment.

In return the company is offering a competitive salary of up to £60,000, overtime, further training and a potential route into further career progression.

Monday to Friday - 08:00am to 17:00pm

Key Responsibilities

  • Preventative Maintenance (PPM): Conduct routine preventative maintenance on diverse chiller systems, including air-cooled, water-cooled, absorption, and adiabatic chillers, to ensure optimal performance and longevity.

  • Carry out F-Gas leak detection, recovery, and recharging in strict compliance with current F-Gas regulations and environmental standards.

  • Participate in an out-of-hours on-call rota for emergency breakdowns as required which is currently every 14 weeks.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior technicians or apprentices when appropriate.
 
In return, my client is offering a very competitive package including:
  • 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays
  • Van & Fuel Card provided
  • Travel time: 1 hour each way
  • Tablet & Work phone provided
  • Full company uniform
  • Lots of overtime available

Qualifications & Experience

  • NVQ Level 2/3 in Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, City & Guilds 2079, or equivalent
  • Current F-Gas Category 1 certification (Essential).
  • Strong track record of working on various commercial and industrial chiller manufacturers.
  • Full, clean UK Driving Licence (Essential)
  • Strong understanding of refrigeration cycles, thermodynamics, electrical control systems, and HVAC principles.
  • Proven ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings to diagnose faults.

job.title: Technical Contract Manager
job.description:
Technical Contract Manager - Law Firm - Central London - 75K

Are you bored in your current role and looking for a new challenge?

Would you like to work for one of the UK's leading service providers?

If so, please read on...

One of the UK's leading service providers is currently looking to recruit a Technical Contract Manager to work on one of their longest standing and most prestigious contracts; a high profile law firm in the city of London.   As a company, they manage properties for a number of well known commercial clients and are considered one of the best in their field.

The main purpose of the role will be to ensure that all technical and service operations across the buildings are maintained to a very high standard.

There will also be a high level of responsibility with regards to compliance, technical systems and contractor management across the contracts.    

Applicants for this role must be able to demonstrate a basic understanding of managing P&L and must also have a good technical understanding.

The main duties will also include:
  • Work closely with the client to make sure that the desired level of service is achieved.
  • Manage and work alongside the appointed maintenance contractors.
  • Manage agreed KPI and SLA’s.
  • Responsible for managing the company’s H&S and environmental performance on site.
  • Responsible for managing the company’s quality procedures on site.
  • Recruitment of any new staff required on sites.
  • Responsible for the technical development of all staff, which will include annual appraisals.
  • Management of client relationships on a daily basis.
  • Management of all reports.
  • Responsible for the permit system.
Applicants for this role must be able to demonstrate the following:
  • Qualified in engineering discipline; C&G, HNC, HND or higher.
  • Strong technical engineering understanding.
  • Previous experience of managing large engineering teams.
  • Experience of service delivery in high profile offices.
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of staff and clients.
  • Ability to manage and prioritise a demanding and varying workload.
  • Ability to deliver projects on time and on budget.
The package for this role includes:
  • Salary 75K.
  • 25 days holiday.
  • Pension.
  • Healthcare.

job.title: Foot Mobile Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Maintenance Engineer – Foot Mobile – Central London – £48,000 + Zones 1–2 Travelcard

Are you an electrically qualified Maintenance Engineer?
Do you have experience working within commercial buildings?
Are you looking for a foot-mobile position offering £48,000 plus travel and overtime?

CBW Staffing Solutions is currently recruiting for an Electrical Foot Mobile Engineer to join a leading FM service provider, covering a portfolio of commercial buildings across The City, Canary Wharf and the West End.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys working across multiple sites rather than being based in one building. You will carry out planned and reactive maintenance across electrical and general building services.

Hours of Work:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 08:00 – 17:00

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Carry out planned and reactive maintenance across multiple commercial sites.
  • Electrical fault finding and repairs.
  • Lighting, emergency lighting, power distribution and small electrical works.
  • Carry out basic mechanical maintenance on AHUs, FCUs, pumps and motors.
  • Monitor plant and equipment through the BMS.
  • Carry out landlord and tenant maintenance where required.
  • Identify faults and ensure plant remains operational.
  • Assist with basic plumbing and fabric maintenance.
  • Escort and oversee specialist subcontractors.
  • Maintain site logbooks and compliance documentation.
  • Liaise professionally with clients and building occupiers.
  • Ensure works are completed in line with health & safety procedures.

Package:
  • £48,000 basic salary
  • Zones 1–2 Travelcard
  • Plenty of overtime available
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays, rising to 28 days with service
  • Private Medical Insurance after probation
  • Company pension
  • Retail discounts
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Season Ticket Loan after six months
  • Ongoing training and career progression

Requirements:
  • City & Guilds Level 2 & 3 Electrical Installation or equivalent
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Proven commercial building maintenance experience.
  • Good electrical fault-finding ability.
  • Multi-skilled with a good understanding of mechanical building services.
  • Strong communication and client-facing skills.
  • Comfortable travelling between sites across Central London.
  • Able to provide copies of relevant trade qualifications.

Please send your CV to Bailey White at CBW Staffing Solutions to avoid missing out on this opportunity.

job.title: Water Treatment Technician
job.description:
Mobile Water Treatment Technician – Birmingham – National Facilities Management Organisation: Commercial & Public Sector

We are currently seeking skilled Mobile Water Treatment Technicians to join our water treatment contract, supporting a large healthcare contract across multiple sites in the West Midlands, with additional coverage across other contracts within the Birmingham and Coventry region.

We are currently recruiting for three positions, with opportunities available for both Experienced and Junior Water Treatment Technicians.

Package
  • Experienced Water Treatment Technician – £35,000 - £37,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Junior Water Treatment Technician – £28,000 - £30,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Van & Fuel Card supplied
  • Core hours are Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
  • Participation in 'out of hours' on call rota
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities
  • Carry out temperature monitoring, showerhead descales, TMV servicing and water sampling
  • Complete cold water storage tank inspections and cleans, along with general water treatment and hygiene duties
  • Carry out water softener servicing, closed system works, chlorine testing and internal chlorifier inspections, where experienced
  • Complete planned and reactive water treatment works across healthcare and commercial sites throughout the region
  • Work in accordance with relevant water hygiene, legionella regulations and client requirements
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation and site logs
  • Work independently or alongside experienced technicians depending on level of experience
  • Support the wider team and continue to develop knowledge and experience across a range of water treatment activities
Qualifications
  • Previous experience within water treatment, water hygiene or legionella is required
  • City & Guilds or NVQ (or equivalent) qualification relevant to the role
  • Up-to-date knowledge of technical regulations including: water supply, regulations/byelaws, L8 ACOP, HSG274
  • Proven ability in fault diagnosis and resolution
  • Relevant industry qualifications would be advantageous
  • Level 2 Plumbing qualification would be desirable for experienced candidates
  • Full, valid UK driving licence
  • Must be able to successfully obtain an Enhanced DBS with Barred Lists check
If you are a Water Treatment Technician and are looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Handyperson
job.description:
Site based Handyperson – Castle Donnington – Global Facilities Management Organisation: Aviation

CBW Staffing Solutions are looking for an experienced and reliable Handyperson to join our client’s on-site facilities team based in Castle Donnington

You’ll be responsible for carrying out reactive repairs to building fabric, with a strong focus on plumbing works and sanitaryware replacements. The role also includes minor joinery, basic decoration, and general maintenance tasks to ensure the site remains safe, functional, and well maintained. This is a hands-on position suited to a multi-skilled individual with a strong background in building fabric and plumbing.

This is a great opportunity to join a well-established facilities management company in a hands-on role that offers variety, stability, and long-term opportunity.

Package:
  • Competitive salary up to £35,000 per annum
  • Core hours are 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday)
  • Participation in on call rota (TBC)
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Responsibilities:
  • Carry out reactive building fabric repairs
  • Perform general plumbing repairs and replace sanitaryware (taps, toilet parts, etc.)
  • Undertake minor joinery and decoration works
  • Support general maintenance tasks to ensure the site remains safe and functional
  • Identify and report faults or defects requiring further attention
  • Assist with planned preventative maintenance tasks where required
Requirements:
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a similar maintenance or handyperson role
  • Strong Plumbing background is strongly advantageous 
  • Strong background in commercial building maintenance
  • Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Physically able to meet the demands of the role (lifting, climbing, standing for long periods)
  • Must be able to pass a DBS check
If you’re an experienced Handyperson looking for a new challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV and contact details.

job.title: Technical Services Manager
job.description:
Technical Services Manager – Media HQ – Holborn - Up to 80K

Would you like to work at a unique building based in Holborn?   

Have you got a proven track record within a technical building services role?

If so please read on...

An excellent opportunity has arisen to join one of the UK's leading companies in the facilities industry.

They currently maintain a number of facilities and maintenance contracts across the UK and are looking for a Technical Services Manager to work on a high profile contract based in Holborn. 

The building houses a well known media company offering a truly unique and totally different working environment.  

The Technical Services Manager will be working alongside the Account Manager and will be responsible for all the technical services and critical engineering in the building, making sure everything runs smoothly and there is no disruption to the day to day client activities. 

Duties of the role will include the following:
  • Manage all technical issues across the building.
  • Issuing permits to work
  • Manage agreed KPI and SLA’s.
  • Responsible for managing the company’s H&S and environmental performance on site.
  • Plan and implement shutdowns 
  • Management of reports.
  • Responsible for the permit system.
  • Managing the engineers and offering technical support and guidance.
Applicants for this role must be able to demonstrate the following:
  • Qualified in electrical or mechanical engineering discipline; C&G, HNC, HND or higher.
  • Strong understanding of building management systems.
  • Previous HV experience - prepared to undertake SAP duties.
  • Strong technical engineering understanding.
  • Previous experience of managing contractors. 
  • Experience of service delivery in high profile financial offices or critical buildings.
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of staff and clients.
  • Ability to manage and prioritise a demanding and varying workload.

job.title: Facilities Engineering / Technical Manager
job.description:
Facilities Engineering / Technical Manager - Client Direct / In-house - Data Centre - Slough - Up to £70,000 per annum 

Are you looking for a role Client side / In-house?
Are you looking to come off Shift?
Are you looking for a role in Slough and have Data Centre experience?

Fantastic opportunity to work as part of the In-house maintenance team for an established Data Centre provider. CBW are currently recruiting for a Facilities Engineering / Technical Manager to be based on a critical data centre in Slough. The successful candidate will be electrically qualified with a proven track record in critical environments (Ideally a Data Centre).

Hours of work

Monday to Friday - 08:00am to 17:00pm
Flexible approach to working hours (Out of hours work)

Key duties & Responsibilities
  • Manage day to day operation including repair and maintenance, Security, change control process, procurement, accounting & budgeting related issue
  • Manage subcontractors and provide a 12 month planner of contractor site visits/ PPMs
  • Manage/execute Data Centre’s expansion, modification, maintenance or new customer move- in projects.
  • Preparation of maintenance contract & tender document.
  • Supervise and liaise with external vendors in respect of regular communications and ad-hoc work and respond to issues that arise.
  • Manages specifications, problems, issues, performance, and administration.
  • Prepare Management report, Power point presentation, SOP/EOP, Critical activities planning such as Power down & Pull-the-Plug test, Emergency / Disaster Recovery plans / Business Continuity Plans, Data Centre customers’ report
  • As an incident manager to manage all incidents and prepare incident reports.
  • Engages with internal stakeholders to gain feedback on customers’ enquiry.
  • Intervenes, analyses, manages and resolves business conflicts between the company and the vendors / suppliers.
  • Implementing procedures of safety system and performance measurement like scorecard to ensure quality and reliability of services meeting client’s requirements.
  • Provide superior customer service to clients through all Facility functions.
  • Routinely inspect all areas to ensure performance measures are being maintained and proactively self- reporting the problems of facilities.
  • Able to track and update on the financial budget.
  • Liaise with MEP, IDC, Security and Office Manager and produce datacentre operation report on a weekly basis.
  • Responsible for Data Centre Facility Management operations.
  • Establish engineering and operation procedures and roll out for site staff.
  • Ensure compliance with all local statutory regulations.
  • Managing all vendors to carry out maintenance for all installations during weekend and review maintenance reports.
  • Provide solutions for technical issues
  • Participate in Disaster Recovery Plan per the Client’s requirement.
  • Manage and Monitor the Data Centre Infrastructure Management System and all sub systems including but not limited to BMS, PMS, and SMS. Update technical drawing regularly / Inventory list / Asset list
  • Audit FM shift handover/performance/work/Procedure monthly and CMI own the right to audit internally.
Requirements
  • City & Guilds Level 2&3 and AM2 or equivalent
  • City & Guilds 18th Edition IEE Regulations
  • Proven track record of handling Uptime Certification is a must.
  • HV & LV Authorised Person (Highly desirable / Not essential)
  • Experience in facilities operation in Data Centre, Telecommunications industry.
  • Able to coordinate with utility company and deal with High Voltage.
  • Knowledge of critical facilities including Chiller, CRAC, UPS, STS
  • Strong leadership, people, and communication skills
  • Strong PC literacy and proven ability to manage daily activities using various systems including MS excel and PowerPoint.
Please send your CV to Katie@cbwstaffingsolutions.com for more information.

job.title: Maintenance Supervisor
job.description:
Maintenance Supervisor – FM Service Provider – St James's Park, London - Up to £60,000 per annum

This is an excellent opportunity within a prominent Central London building. The property combines character and architectural significance with modern operational requirements, providing a diverse and fast-paced environment that supports a range of occupiers, stakeholders, and day-to-day activities.

The role involves overseeing the delivery of high-quality building services across a complex and busy occupied environment, ensuring planned and reactive maintenance activities are carried out efficiently and to the highest standards. The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers, focusing strongly on statutory compliance, contractor management, operational performance, and stakeholder engagement to support seamless day-to-day operations. This position is ideally suited to an ambitious and career-driven individual seeking long-term progression within a dynamic and prestigious estate environment, offering exposure to a unique blend of heritage assets, public spaces, and operationally critical facilities.

Hours of Work

Monday to Friday, 08:00am – 17:00pm

Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Supervise and coordinate building maintenance engineers and specialist subcontractors
  • Ensure all planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive works are delivered to required standards
  • Review, approve, and manage RAMS (Risk Assessments & Method Statements)
  • Issue and control Permits to Work in line with site safety procedures
  • Monitor and update CAFM systems, ensuring accurate maintenance records
  • Ensure full compliance with Health & Safety legislation and company policies
  • Produce reports, track KPIs/SLAs, and support contract performance reviews
  • Liaise with clients, tenants, and internal teams to maintain high service levels
  • Identify plant or system defects and coordinate remedial works
  • Assist with quotations, scopes of work, and technical recommendations
  • Support the Contract Manager with day-to-day contract delivery and continuous improvement
Requirements
  • Electrically or Mechanically qualified (City & Guilds Level 2/3 or equivalent)
  • Previous supervisory or lead experience within FM/building services
  • Strong understanding of RAMS, permits to work, and compliance processes
  • Experience using CAFM systems and producing reports
  • Good knowledge of commercial building services (HVAC, electrical, etc.)
  • Commercial and or Residential experience
  • Excellent customer service skills

job.title: Maintenance Electrician
job.description:
Site based Maintenance Electrician - Castle Donington - National Facilities Management Organisation: Aviation

CBW Staffing Solutions are seeking a skilled Maintenance Electrician to join our client on a permanent basis, who are a leading provider in facilities management solutions, delivering top-tier services across the commercial industry.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical maintenance within commercial settings, as they will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining electrical systems and equipment to ensure optimal functionality and safety.

This is a site based opportunity, located in Castle Donington, Derbyshire.

Package
  • Competitive salary up to £45,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Core hours are Monday - Friday (40 hours per week)
  • Participation in 'out of hours' on call rota
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities

Responsibilities
  • Conduct routine inspections of electrical systems to identify and resolve issues promptly
  • Perform preventive maintenance tasks to minimise downtime and ensure the longevity of electrical equipment
  • Troubleshoot electrical faults and implement effective solutions to restore functionality
  • Install, repair, and maintain electrical components, such as wiring, circuit breakers, and lighting fixtures
  • Collaborate with other maintenance personnel and contractors to coordinate repairs and upgrades
  • Adhere to safety protocols and regulations to create a secure working environment

Qualifications
  • Qualified to at least City & Guilds Level 3 in Electrical Installation or equivalent
  • Proven experience as a Maintenance Electrician or similar role within the facilities management industry
  • Strong knowledge of electrical systems, wiring, and circuitry
  • Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing electrical faults
  • Familiarity with electrical codes and regulations
  • Ability to read technical diagrams and blueprints
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities

If you are a dedicated Maintenance Electrician looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Mechanical Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer – FM Service Provider – Law Firm – Moorgate, London – £48,000

CBW Staffing Solutions is currently recruiting for a Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer to join a facilities management team based at a commercial building in Moorgate, London covering 5 tenanted floors of a law firm.

job.title: Area General Manager
job.description:
Area General Manager - Leading Hard FM Services Provider - London - Up to 100k plus package

Are you an experienced senior manager looking for a new challenge?

Are you an Account Manager or Operations Manager looking for the next step in your career?

Do you have experience managing multi-site maintenance contracts?

A brilliant opportunity to work for a Leading FM Service Provider based across a blue chip commercial portfolio in London has arisen.

My client is looking for an Area General Manager to manage a blue chip commercial portfolio situated in Central London.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record in commercial building maintenance and hold previous Senior Account Manager / Operations Manager experience.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the management and development of a end user hard services portfolio with a value in the region £8m with room for future growth and development.

In return the company is offering a competitive salary & package, further training and the opportunity to work for a company considered a market leader in its field.

Working in conjunction with the clients on various blue chip sites and reporting into Business Unit Director, the successful candidate will be required to carry out the following duties.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Excellent influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Strong financial skills.
  • Ability to manage conflict and crisis situations effectively.
  • Provide leadership, and ensuring the planned development of a portfolio of contracts to ensure that contractual commitments are met and exceeded.
  • Ensure that opportunities for the strategic development of contracts are explored to deliver increased turnover and profitability.
  • Ensuring business policies and processes are effectively communicated, and implemented within contracts.
  • Ensure additional services and projects are added, and contracts are re-won on re-tender.
  • Development of financial plans for revenue and profit delivery, reduction of WIP, debt, cost reduction and contract growth.
  • Ensure appropriate contract review, audit and control systems to ensure statutory, policy and contractual commitments are met.
  • Ensuring a customer focus within all areas of operational activities, and that effective relationships are maintained with key client contacts.
  • Accountable day-to-day to the relevant client contacts.
  • Line management responsibility for a small team, primarily comprising contract managers across a portfolio of contracts.
  • Financial responsibility for the delivery of plan commitments for the contract portfolio.
  • The development and review of teams, appraisal, and the application of effective people management practice.
Hours of Work & Salary/Package:
  • Salary £100000
  • £5000 car allowance
  • 20% Bonus
  • Monday to Friday (40 hour week) 8.00am – 17:00pm
Requirements:
  • Hard services background with recognised electrical or mechanical qualifications.
  • Managerial experience at Account Manager or above within technical and or hard services is essential.
  • Proven experience within the commercial blue chip maintenance industry.
  • Excellent motivational and influencing skills, with high levels of personal integrity.

  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.

  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.

  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.

  • Company pension.

job.title: Electrical Compliance Supervisor
job.description:
Electrical Compliance Supervisor - Glasgow - Salary up to £45,000 DOE

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Compliance Supervisor to join a growing renewable energy business delivering a high volume of domestic energy installations across Scotland.

This is a hands-on technical and supervisory position, responsible for maintaining consistently high standards of electrical quality, compliance and safety across a busy installation programme. You will work closely with a small team of Compliance Inspectors, installation teams and site management, carrying out both remote and on-site inspections across Solar PV, battery storage, Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP) and Electrical Storage Heating installations.

The role offers a genuine mix of technical, field and office-based responsibilities, including reviewing electrical certification and photographic evidence, supporting installers with technical queries, identifying quality issues and providing coaching and training to installation and inspection teams.

There is also the opportunity for the successful candidate to become, or work towards becoming, a NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and support a team of Compliance Inspectors, ensuring inspection activity keeps pace with a high-volume installation programme.
  • Carry out remote and on-site inspections, reviewing workmanship, materials, installation methods and supporting documentation.
  • Apply strong practical electrical knowledge to assess the installation, wiring, configuration and commissioning of inverters and battery storage systems.
  • Identify and troubleshoot electrical and system faults both remotely and on-site.
  • Provide technical support to installation teams, inspectors and customers, acting as a key point of contact for electrical and system-related queries.
  • Support the training and development of site and office-based colleagues, enabling effective first-line fault diagnosis and technical triage.
  • Liaise with manufacturers and equipment suppliers to resolve technical issues, faults and warranty matters.
  • Monitor installation quality and identify examples of best and poor practice, feeding learning into toolbox talks, training and best-practice guidance.
  • Deliver technical updates, toolbox talks and product awareness sessions to installation and inspection teams.
  • Review photographic evidence and job documentation to ensure installations can be effectively inspected remotely.
  • Ensure electrical installation work meets relevant engineering specifications, BS 7671, NICEIC requirements, MCS standards and applicable health, safety and environmental requirements.
  • Review electrical certificates, including EICs, Minor Works Certificates and EICRs, for accuracy and compliance.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete and meets relevant renewable energy certification requirements before sign-off.
  • Support internal and external quality, compliance and regulatory audits.
Person Specification: You will be an experienced electrical professional with a strong understanding of renewable energy installations and a genuine interest in maintaining high standards of workmanship and compliance.

  • A strong electrical installation background with relevant industry experience.
  • Practical knowledge of Solar PV, battery storage and associated inverter systems.
  • Experience of electrical inspection, testing and fault finding.
  • Good working knowledge of BS 7671.
  • Understanding of MCS requirements and renewable energy compliance.
  • Experience reviewing electrical certification and installation documentation.
  • The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues both remotely and on-site.
  • NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor experience or an individual working towards this level would be highly desirable.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £45,000 DOE
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Project Coordinator
job.description:
Project Coordinator - Glasgow - Salary up to £30,000 DOE 

We are looking for an organised and proactive Project Coordinator to support the successful delivery of a growing portfolio of renewable energy installation programmes.

The role will involve managing schedules, coordinating site activity, maintaining accurate project records and providing clear progress reporting to ensure projects remain on programme. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with strong coordination or project administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with multiple moving parts.

Key Responsibilities
  • Coordinate installation schedules across multiple live renewable energy programmes, aligning surveyor, installer and contractor availability with project deadlines.
  • Work closely with Project Managers to sequence works efficiently and, where practical, group projects geographically to minimise travel and downtime.
  • Confirm site access, customer appointments and pre-installation requirements ahead of scheduled works.
  • Maintain and regularly update programme schedules, ensuring changes, delays and completed works are accurately reflected.
  • Prepare, issue and track job packs, ensuring required documentation, permissions and compliance information are in place before works commence.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records, including job information, timesheets, installation evidence and completion documentation.
  • Follow up outstanding documentation with surveyors, installers and contractors and escalate persistent issues where required.
  • Support the preparation and collation of MCS, grant and funder-related documentation ahead of submission deadlines.
  • Ensure project records are complete, accurate and readily accessible throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Escalate customer concerns or complaints promptly to the appropriate Project Manager.
  • Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support smooth project delivery.
  • Produce regular project and programme progress reports covering scheduled, completed and outstanding works.
  • Maintain accurate project data and ensure information is consistent across relevant systems.
  • Support Project Managers with data, reports and administrative packs for client meetings, project reviews, tenders and funder reporting.
  • Identify discrepancies or gaps in project information and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
  • Assist with the preparation of project tenders, including the collation of supporting documentation, method statements and pricing information.
  • Support the mobilisation of new projects and programmes by establishing job tracking, documentation and reporting processes.
  • Assist Project Managers with general project administration throughout the project lifecycle, from mobilisation through to completion and handover.
Person Specification:
  • Previous experience in project coordination, project support or project administration.
  • Experience within construction, installation, engineering, property, retrofit or renewable energy would be advantageous.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple schedules, deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when dealing with project records and compliance documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A professional and confident approach when dealing with customers, contractors and internal teams.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • The ability to learn and use project management and job-tracking systems quickly.
  • A proactive approach to identifying scheduling conflicts, resource issues and potential project delays.
  • The ability to remain calm and methodical when managing a high volume of live projects and changing priorities.
Salary & Benefits:
  • Salary up to £30,000 DOE
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

Successful candidates will join dedicated installation teams, working together to deliver high-quality renewable energy systems safely, efficiently, and to industry standards.

Each installation team typically consists of:

  • Solar PV Roofer – Responsible for all roofing and mechanical aspects of the installation, including mounting systems, solar panel installation, weatherproofing, and providing day-to-day guidance to the site labourer.
  • Renewable Energy Electricians (2 positions per team) – Responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, and certification of Solar PV and Battery Storage systems, including AC/DC wiring, inverters, and associated electrical equipment in accordance with current industry regulations.
  • Skilled Labourer/ Electricians Mate– Provides general site support, material handling, and assistance to both the roofing and electrical teams while gaining valuable experience within the renewable energy industry.
We're particularly interested in hearing from applicants who already work as part of an established installation team, as well as individuals who know experienced colleagues looking for their next opportunity. Whether you're applying as a complete team, a pair of colleagues, or as an individual with recommendations, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist electricians with the installation of Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV charging and ASHP systems.
  • Support with AC/DC cable routing, containment, trunking and general electrical preparation works.
  • Help with installation of inverters, isolators, consumer units and associated equipment under supervision.
  • Carry out basic testing support duties where directed.
  • Maintain a safe, tidy and organised working environment at all times.
  • Assist with loading/unloading materials and preparing site setups.
  • Follow all Health & Safety procedures and work as part of a structured installation team.
Person Specification:

Essential:

  • Basic understanding of electrical installation work.
  • ECS Labourer Card (or willingness to obtain).
  • Good awareness of Health & Safety practices on construction sites.
  • Physically fit and comfortable working in a hands-on role.
  • Reliable, punctual and able to follow instructions accurately.
  • Willingness to learn and develop within the electrical trade.
  • Full UK driving licence preferred.
Desirable:

You will be responsible for the successful delivery of electrical and hard services, ensuring contractual obligations, service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently achieved.

The role will involve overseeing electrical engineering resources, including HV and LV systems, while ensuring critical infrastructure remains safe, compliant and operational. You will take responsibility for planned, reactive and lifecycle maintenance, working closely with operational teams, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.

This is a key leadership position requiring a strong combination of technical knowledge, people management, commercial awareness and operational experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead, manage and support electrical engineering teams to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required standards.
  • Maintain the reliability and integrity of critical electrical systems while minimising equipment and asset downtime.
  • Oversee planned preventative and reactive maintenance activities, ensuring work is completed within agreed timescales and properly documented.
  • Manage CAFM systems, including work allocation, asset information, maintenance schedules and reporting.
  • Ensure Safe Systems of Work and Permit to Work procedures are consistently applied.
  • Provide leadership for Authorised Persons (APs) and Competent Persons (CPs), ensuring technical appointments and responsibilities are appropriately managed.
  • Coordinate additional works, lifecycle replacement programmes and the procurement of equipment and materials.
  • Monitor external contractors and supply chain partners, ensuring performance, compliance, quality and safety requirements are maintained.
  • Promote a positive Health, Safety and Environmental culture through regular inspections, reporting and proactive risk management.
  • Ensure statutory, technical and contractual documentation remains accurate and up to date.
  • Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring any identified actions are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders, attending meetings and providing accurate performance updates and reports.
  • Maintain training records, competency information and technical appointment registers.
  • Manage team performance, including appraisals, development plans and ongoing training requirements.
  • Work closely with the central Service Desk to support workforce planning and maintain operational continuity.
  • Ensure operational procedures, LOPs and technical documentation remain compliant with legislation and industry best practice.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours/on-call management rota as required.
  • Prepare regular contract performance, energy management and operational reports.
  • Monitor budgets, expenditure and financial forecasts to ensure effective commercial management.
  • Support and promote organisational values relating to ethics, equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties required by the Line Manager.
Benefits and Package The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
  • Life assurance equivalent to twice your annual salary.
  • Employee discounts with a wide range of major retailers and brands.
  • Gym membership discounts.
  • Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Holiday purchase scheme.
  •  £55,000 plus uplift for AP And HP and on-ca;;
Essential Requirements
  • HNC/HND in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
  • Recognised electrical qualifications and/or fully qualified electrician status.
  • At least five years' post-qualification experience within a comparable technical or contract management position.
  • Demonstrable experience managing electrical and hard services within a contractual environment.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Good commercial and financial management experience.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Disclosure Scotland/PVG clearance.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and CAFM systems.
Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience working within healthcare facilities management.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare technical standards, including SHTM 06-01, SHTM 06-02 and SHTM 06-03.
  • LV and HV Authorised/Approved Person experience or certification.
  • Knowledge of Confined Spaces, Fire Safety and Lift management.
  • Experience managing projects and delivering works within a live operational environment.

  • Complete detailed and auditable technical reports, including test results, readings, photographs, findings and recommended remedial action.

  • Provide professional customer service within occupied residential properties.

  • £5 bonus for every positive customer review
  • 28 days’ annual leave, including Bank Holidays
  • Company pension

  • Ongoing training and career progression
Requirements
  • Current domestic ACS qualifications, including CCN1 and CENWAT.

  • Extensive experience diagnosing complex and recurring boiler, heating and hot-water faults.
  • Strong understanding of S-plan, Y-plan, multi-zone, open-vented and sealed heating systems.
  • Strong knowledge of heating controls, wiring centres and electrical fault finding.

  • Previous experience of performing a Building Services Engineer role
  • Must be able to work unsupervised to a high quality
Please send your CV to Charlie Long of CBW Staffing Solutions to avoid missing out on the role !

job.title: Electrical Technical Manager
job.description:
Technical Services Manager - Fife  Hours: 37.5 hours per week Working Hours: Flexible between 7:00am and 5:00pm

CBW are seeking an experienced Technical Services Manager – Electrical to provide effective leadership and technical management across a complex healthcare facilities environment.

You will be responsible for the successful delivery of electrical and hard services, ensuring contractual obligations, service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently achieved.

The role will involve overseeing electrical engineering resources, including HV and LV systems, while ensuring critical infrastructure remains safe, compliant and operational. You will take responsibility for planned, reactive and lifecycle maintenance, working closely with operational teams, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.

This is a key leadership position requiring a strong combination of technical knowledge, people management, commercial awareness and operational experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead, manage and support electrical engineering teams to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required standards.
  • Maintain the reliability and integrity of critical electrical systems while minimising equipment and asset downtime.
  • Oversee planned preventative and reactive maintenance activities, ensuring work is completed within agreed timescales and properly documented.
  • Manage CAFM systems, including work allocation, asset information, maintenance schedules and reporting.
  • Ensure Safe Systems of Work and Permit to Work procedures are consistently applied.
  • Provide leadership for Authorised Persons (APs) and Competent Persons (CPs), ensuring technical appointments and responsibilities are appropriately managed.
  • Coordinate additional works, lifecycle replacement programmes and the procurement of equipment and materials.
  • Monitor external contractors and supply chain partners, ensuring performance, compliance, quality and safety requirements are maintained.
  • Promote a positive Health, Safety and Environmental culture through regular inspections, reporting and proactive risk management.
  • Ensure statutory, technical and contractual documentation remains accurate and up to date.
  • Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring any identified actions are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders, attending meetings and providing accurate performance updates and reports.
  • Maintain training records, competency information and technical appointment registers.
  • Manage team performance, including appraisals, development plans and ongoing training requirements.
  • Work closely with the central Service Desk to support workforce planning and maintain operational continuity.
  • Ensure operational procedures, LOPs and technical documentation remain compliant with legislation and industry best practice.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours/on-call management rota as required.
  • Prepare regular contract performance, energy management and operational reports.
  • Monitor budgets, expenditure and financial forecasts to ensure effective commercial management.
  • Support and promote organisational values relating to ethics, equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties required by the Line Manager.
Benefits and Package The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
  • Life assurance equivalent to twice your annual salary.
  • Employee discounts with a wide range of major retailers and brands.
  • Gym membership discounts.
  • Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Holiday purchase scheme.
  •  
Essential Requirements
  • HNC/HND in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
  • Recognised electrical qualifications and/or fully qualified electrician status.
  • At least five years' post-qualification experience within a comparable technical or contract management position.
  • Demonstrable experience managing electrical and hard services within a contractual environment.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Good commercial and financial management experience.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Disclosure Scotland/PVG clearance.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and CAFM systems.
Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience working within healthcare facilities management.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare technical standards, including SHTM 06-01, SHTM 06-02 and SHTM 06-03.
  • LV and HV Authorised/Approved Person experience or certification.
  • Knowledge of Confined Spaces, Fire Safety and Lift management.
  • Experience managing projects and delivering works within a live operational environment.
